title: Divide Players Into Teams of Equal Skill
summary: Given a positive integer array skill with an even length, divide the players into pairs where each pair has the same total skill.
statement: Given a positive integer array skill with an even length, divide the players into pairs where each pair has the same total skill. Calculate the product of skills for each pair and return the sum of these products. If it's impossible to form such pairs, return -1.
constraints: Pair every player exactly once, with all pairs required to have the same skill sum.
A pair’s chemistry is the product of its two skills.
Return total chemistry, or -1 if equal-sum pairing is impossible.
reference_solution:
def equal_skill_pair_chemistry(skill):
    values=sorted(skill);target=values[0]+values[-1];answer=0
    for left in range(len(values)//2):
        right=len(values)-1-left
        if values[left]+values[right]!=target:return -1
        answer+=values[left]*values[right]
    return answer

hints: Sort skills and pair the smallest remaining value with the largest remaining value.
Their sum fixes the only possible common target.
Verify every inward pair has that sum while accumulating products.
In any equal-sum pairing the global smallest must pair with the global largest; removing them repeats the same forced argument.
